title: 大狗大狗叫叫叫 - BigDogBark
description: 将弓和三叉戟的蓄力和发射音效改为大狗叫 - Changed the charge and firing sound effects of bows and tridents to bigdogbark
body:
## 模组内容 将弓和三叉戟的蓄力和发射音效改为大狗叫。
蓄力时「大狗」会随时间提高音调和播放速度，并在发射时「叫」出来。
#### 支持版本 - Fabric 1.20.1 / 1.21.1 - Forge 1.20.1 / 1.21.1 - NeoForge 1.21.1 ## Mod Info Changed the charge and firing sound effects of bows and tridents to bigdogbark.
When charged, the "Big Dog" will gradually increase its pitch and playback speed, and will "bark" when launched.
#### Supports - Fabric 1.20.1 / 1.21.1 - Forge 1.20.1 / 1.21.1 - NeoForge 1.21.1
